lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately 8-9 vertical columns. Spacing between spots increases along the anterior-posterior axis, with higher density and smaller diameters observed towards the anterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity coincide with the vertical columns of spots, creating a rectilinear grid where blobs act as intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a pronounced luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced low-intensity region immediately ventral.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin contains a high-density cluster of small, low-diameter high-intensity spots that lack the structured grid arrangement seen on the lateral flank.
